item.title: [ 53] /pcbg/ - PC Building General
item.description:
>UPGRADE & BUILD ADVICE
Post build list or current specs including MONITOR: https://pcpartpicker.com/
Provide specific use cases
State BUDGET and COUNTRY or you will NOT be helped

>CASE
mATX: AP201, Lian Li A3/B4, XT M3
ATX: XT PRO (ULTRA), Lancool 207/217, Flux Pro, Meshify 3, 4000D FRAME, X50, BF360 Flow, HAF II 500
Dual Chamber: Y60/70, O11 Vision, Antec C8

>CPU
Budget: 7500F, 7/9600/X, 225F, 12400F, 5600/X
Gaming: 9850X3D, 9/7800X3D, 250K, 5800X3D
Workstation: 9950X/3D(2), 9900X/3D, 270K

>COOLER
AIO: Thermalright Frozen Edge, Cooler Master Atmos, Lian Li GA II Lite, Nautilus RS, Silent Loop 3, Noctua NL-LC1
Dual tower: A620 PRO SE, Phantom Spirit, NH-D15 G2
ITX/>42mm RAM: AXP120-X67, Mugen 6 Dual Fan

TIM: Duronaut, MX-7, PTM7950* (phase change), KryoSheet (graphene pad)
*Most online PTM7950 listings are counterfeit

>MOTHERBOARD
Avoid ASRock AM5 boards, CPU degradation issues still reported
Choose boards with ALC1220 audio codec when possible

>RAM
DDR5: 2x16GB or 2x24GB, 6000CL30 (AMD), 6400CL32 (Intel)
Workstation: 2x 32GB (budget), 2x48GB or 2x64GB (high-end)
DDR4: 3200CL16, 3600CL18

>SSD (update firmware)
Avoid Crucial, they no longer replace failed SSDs under warranty
DRAMless: (SN)7100, C925G, NM790
PCIe Gen 4.0: (SN)850X
Gen 5.0: (SN)8100
https://borecraft.com/

>GPU
Buy the best one you're willing to pay for
Avoid poor value entry-level GPUs like RTX 3050 & RX 6500 XT

>PSU
Buying guide:
https://hwbusters.com/best_picks/best-atxv3-pcie5-ready-psus-picks-hardware-busters/

>MONITOR
Budget: 165/180Hz IPS (24" 1080p / 27" 1440p)
HDR: discounted OLED or MiniLED (IPS/VA: motion clarity vs. contrast)
High-end: wait for 2027 OLED releases
Check reviews & owner feedback

>OS
Activate Windows @ >>>/g/fwt

>CASE FANS
Meta: Case with good stock PWM fans
Midrange: Pure Wings 3, Arctic P-Pro (5-pack, loud @ higher RPM)
High-end: Fractal Momentum, Noctua G2 (140mm or 120mm)

Paid rare files that are basically impossible to find again, personal shit, memories, etc. all gone in a second.

I know I should've backed everything up, but backing up 10TB is a massive fucking time sink, so I kept putting it off. Classic “I'll do it later” cope. Cloud was never an option either. Some of these files are way too sensitive to trust to a third party.

I did dump some of the really important stuff onto a 2TB drive a while back, but the bulk of it, especially the older onion content, is just gone.

Not making this mistake twice. I need an actual robust local backup setup that can handle 10TB+ without turning backups into another fucking chore.

Is buying a proper NAS worth it at this point? Expensive as fuck, but if it means I never have to deal with this again, I'm willing to pay.

What's the actual minimum decent setup for this? No cloud. Ideally something that's mostly automatic and doesn't require me to babysit backups every week.

item.title: [ 31] We're running out of missiles
item.description:
US watchdog tallies Iran war’s hit to weapons stockpiles, military bases and more

https://apnews.com/article/iran-war-damage-pentagon-inspector-general-87cbe4e2ac208a849cd1554c4bb44bbf

WASHINGTON (AP) — A U.S. government watchdog released its first report Monday on the impact of the Iran war, acknowledging the military’s advanced weapons shortfalls and offering the first public look at the damage to American aircraft, bases and diplomatic outposts in the Middle East.

Much of the information has been previously reported over the past six months, but the Pentagon inspector general’s report offered the fullest official accounting so far of the conflict’s costs in American lives, taxpayer dollars and physical damage. It included information from the watchdogs for the Defense and State departments as well as the U.S. Agency for International Development.

The report, whose publication was first reported by NBC News, noted that the U.S. war with Iran “has resulted in strategic inventory shortfalls and revealed industrial base bottlenecks for munitions resupply” in regard to advanced weapons. Experts have previously said it will take about three years for military contractors to replenish advanced missiles and defensive missile interceptors to prewar levels.

The Pentagon has repeatedly pushed back against reports of any munitions shortage, saying the U.S. military has all the weapons it needs to fight any conflict. President Donald Trump said in a social media post Monday that the U.S. is “producing more Exquisite and Elite Weapons than at any time in our History.”

“They are being delivered on a daily basis to our Forces in the Middle East, and beyond,” he wrote.

item.title: [106] Trump sides with Putin, again, calls on Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian diesel fuel
item.description:
https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-drones-odesa-refinery-border-crossing-17bb6a0401abc3eaa7d4586150a41d7d

KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday called on Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries and other infrastructure used to produce and distribute diesel, saying the attacks are causing a global shortage. He spoke after diesel prices in the U.S. hit a record on Friday, soaring past $6 a gallon on average.

Ukraine has for months been targeting Russia’s oil and gas industry with long-range strikes, prompting fuel rationing across the country and causing Moscow to ban diesel exports in July, removing supplies from the already tight global market.

But the global crunch also came after the war on Iran curtailed oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

Fuel prices are weighing on Americans as they prepare to vote in midterm elections in November.

Trump was asked by a reporter if he had spoken with Zelenskyy following his recent conversation with Russia’s Vladimir Putin. He responded by calling on Zelenskyy to halt strikes against Russia.

“Mr. Zelenskyy has to do one thing. He has to stop knocking out diesel fuel in Russia,” Trump told reporters on the sidelines of the Irish Open, which is being played at his Doonbeg golf club.

“We spoke to Mr. Zelenskyy about it. There are plenty of other targets. Don’t hit diesel fuel, because that’s hurting, that’s hurting the world,” he said.

Diesel exports from Gulf countries way down since Iran war began

According to a report published Friday by the International Energy Agency, net exports of diesel and gasoil from the Gulf countries in August stood at “just over a quarter” of what they were before the war on Iran began in February.

Her story could have been set in a human setting, or a sci-fi one, or anything inbetween and, besides a few touch-ups here and there, there wouldnt be any major difference

item.title: [154] Real Traveler's map™ thread
item.description:
Post your travel maps in this thread. Pic related is the official /trv/ Real Traveler's map™, edition 4.0.5. I am remaking this general after almost a year of it being dead, so this is not the usual OP.

Fill in the countries and subdivisions you have visited, talk about your map and ask others about their maps. You can use the map however you like, the colors are more like suggestions, you don't have to use them, and you don't have to use all of them. You can add or remove colors and change the map as much as you want in any way you want. Don't like this map? Upload a completely different one. Up to you. Despite what some might say, there's no "wrong" way to use the map, and new posters and less travelled people are welcome and encouraged to stay and post :) This map is a group effort by our board, and we can only improve it if people reach out to share suggestions or corrections.

This is the newest edition of the map, edition 4.0.5, updated for September 2025. Thanks to an Anon in previous threads, it is now easier than ever to fill in the map. You can use the website splored.com to easily color in entire countries with a single click. At the time of making this thread, it uses the old 4.0.4 template, so you still need to update it to 4.0.5 with the simplified template, but hopefully it will be updated.
